proposalCreate.title: Vital Rehearsal rc4 evidence and the preserved 220-outcome roadmap
proposalCreate.body:
The owner approved publishing the prepared plan accompanying the explicitly unreviewed rc4 prerelease: https://github.com/thepianistdirector/vital-rehearsal/releases/tag/v1.0.0rc4.

This proposal preserves the old discussion proposal prp_e78d47cc6b905baa3e96fd4c6ad46f52, its revision and votes. It does not bind expanded content to that historical Yes option. The canonical ledger has 244 records: 27 unchanged historical records plus 217 scoped successors. Native publication selects 220 unique outcomes (217 successors and three foundations) across 28 waves, with structured dependencies, wave outcomes, source lineage, risks, scopes and explicit evidence status.

The finite v1.0 local product and three methodological/engineering drafts have separate automated review and reproducibility evidence. Final public v1.0 acceptance still requires qualified interpretation review and external human reproduction. A saved/submitted/reviewed/accepted/published native plan is not evidence of completed task execution.

Read the canonical plan and all individual task briefs before the exact option is decided. No fabricated votes or native completion states are permitted. The 244-record source ledger and 27-record lineage are linked from https://github.com/thepianistdirector/vital-rehearsal/blob/3b00d8e71a0b4f8d577be0c4c6f25a545a8c3faf/plan/tasks.json . Long-term aspirational work does not expand the finite rc4 promise or grant additional resources.

canonicalWaves.name: Accepted architecture and planning foundation
canonicalWaves.outcome: Preserved accepted documentation and repository-plan tooling; no scientific completion inferred.
exitEvidence: Immutable foundation STATUS.md at the recorded source commit.

canonicalWaves.name: One cardiopulmonary case is admissible
canonicalWaves.outcome: A maintainer-reviewed decision passes executable completeness, rights, context and comparator gates or preserves HOLD; no model is substituted silently.
exitEvidence: VR-W01-01: Compare a pinned Pulse validation case and a published CellML/SED-ML case against all fourteen NEXT_WORK questions; required unknowns produce HOLD.
VR-W01-02: Record separate code, model, scenario, reference and derived-output terms; missing rights prevent acquisition or redistribution of that component.
VR-W01-03: A reviewed card states reference subject, mechanisms, observables, horizon and exclusions; unsupported patient or perturbation claims fail admission.
VR-W01-04: Every requested observable has source-linked units, precision and justified criteria fixed before outputs are inspected; guessed thresholds are rejected.
VR-W01-05: Exact direct and transitive versions, licenses, execution/network behavior, resource needs and replacement path are reviewed before installation.
VR-W01-06: A bounded retrieval recipe identifies immutable executable inputs and numeric references with permitted storage; absent files remain unknown.
VR-W01-07: Record reviewer qualifications, exact card revision, interpretation scope and unresolved concerns; unavailable reviewers remain pending.
VR-W01-08: A maintainer-reviewed decision passes executable completeness, rights, context and comparator gates or preserves HOLD; no model is substituted silently.

canonicalWaves.name: A study is explicit and executable
canonicalWaves.outcome: A documented standard-library control validates supported contracts and catches malformed units without claiming an admitted physiological run.
exitEvidence: VR-W02-01: Unknown fields, missing required values, duplicate JSON keys and unsupported schema versions fail before execution; changes create a new study identity.
VR-W02-02: Incompatible units, semantic quantity mismatches, nonfinite numbers and out-of-range inputs fail with named field errors using a documented supported subset.
VR-W02-03: The study identifies exact model/card/source revisions and prevents an admitted fixture from being silently exchanged for another version.
VR-W02-04: Study identity includes immutable comparator and evaluation settings; a changed tolerance or reference requires a new identity and cannot alter an existing attempt.
VR-W02-05: Repeated requests receive distinct attempt identities or explicit reconciliation; no completed attempt can be overwritten by a retry.
VR-W02-06: Patient, controlled-access, unsupported clinical and untrusted-code requests are rejected; reviewed built-in controls remain explicitly non-physiology.
VR-W02-07: A researcher can validate a study without running it; invalid input produces a nonzero exit and a field-specific correction without private-path disclosure.
VR-W02-08: A documented standard-library control validates supported contracts and catches malformed units without claiming an admitted physiological run.

canonicalWaves.name: The physiology reference actually runs
canonicalWaves.outcome: The actual admitted adapter executes the pinned reference inputs and all predeclared observable comparisons are reported with limitations.
exitEvidence: VR-W03-01: The reviewed adapter maps every source-defined initial and boundary value without undocumented defaults; a missing parameter prevents startup.
VR-W03-02: A real adapter run records engine release, solver configuration, runtime and supported CPU environment sufficient to explain numerical differences.
VR-W03-03: Source-defined stabilization and sample schedule are applied explicitly; pre-stabilization data cannot enter the comparison interval.
VR-W03-04: The adapter emits all admitted observable trajectories in declared units and retains original numeric output without hidden smoothing or imputation.
VR-W03-05: Timeout, bounded output and scrubbed subprocess environment are exercised; documentation states these controls are not a sandbox.
VR-W03-06: Initialization failure, solver rejection and abnormal process exit preserve raw diagnostics and distinct failure reasons.
VR-W03-07: Malformed output, wrong engine identity and missing diagnostics terminate the attempt rather than being interpreted as valid trajectories.
VR-W03-08: The actual admitted adapter executes the pinned reference inputs and all predeclared observable comparisons are reported with limitations.

canonicalWaves.name: Numerical failures cannot masquerade as findings
canonicalWaves.outcome: The admitted adapter's real raw trajectory passes completeness and predeclared source-based evaluation, with negative controls and unassessed uncertainties visible.
exitEvidence: VR-W04-01: The evaluator checks exact observable set, ordered time grid, row completeness and declared units before calculating any agreement result.
VR-W04-02: Each observable reports the predeclared numerical criterion, measured error and bounded conclusion; a scalar score cannot conceal a failed observable.
VR-W04-03: NaN, infinity, impossible supported states and truncated output receive explicit invalid states and no favorable score.
VR-W04-04: An independently calculable numeric fixture and a deliberately wrong counterpart exercise comparison behavior; both are labeled non-physiology controls.
VR-W04-05: A changed output fails its frozen criterion; applicable conservation rules reject an injected residual, while inapplicable conservation is labeled unassessed.
VR-W04-06: Nonconverged execution, unsupported input, evaluator error and completed disagreement remain distinguishable in result and CLI exit behavior.
VR-W04-07: Every evaluation binds code/settings/reference identity and preserves failures; producers cannot replace criteria inside a retained attempt.
VR-W04-08: The admitted adapter's real raw trajectory passes completeness and predeclared source-based evaluation, with negative controls and unassessed uncertainties visible.

canonicalWaves.name: An external researcher can reproduce the case
canonicalWaves.outcome: Authorized native tasks and waves expose actual counts, dependencies, scope and 0.1 access; unpublished drafts or pending proposals cannot pass.
exitEvidence: VR-W05-01: JSON metadata, raw outputs, diagnostics and manifest become visible together; incomplete staging never appears as a completed result.
VR-W05-02: Interrupt after partial output, preserve the prior complete bundle, identify the interrupted attempt and rerun under a reconciled or fresh identity.
VR-W05-03: Offline reports expose scope, provenance, per-observable findings and failures; HTML has labels, keyboard access and usable narrow/zoomed layouts.
VR-W05-04: A versioned source or installable CLI package declares exact runtime/dependency requirements and lawful fixture or retrieval instructions.
VR-W05-05: The packaged candidate performs validate-run-evaluate-inspect and interruption recovery on the declared CPU environment with real physiology evidence.
VR-W05-06: A qualified reviewer assesses the exact claims and a real researcher completes the workflow; agent checks are recorded separately and never substitute.
VR-W05-07: A fresh external researcher obtains the public release and reproduces supported results plus a recovery path; identity, environment and discrepancies are retained.
VR-W05-08: After exact candidate approval and distribution-rights clearance, the public version and artifacts are read back without developer credentials.
VR-W05-09: Authorized native tasks and waves expose actual counts, dependencies, scope and 0.1 access; unpublished drafts or pending proposals cannot pass.

canonicalWaves.name: Model cards delimit scientific use
canonicalWaves.outcome: A review samples every supported input and observable against the exact card; an uncovered request fails the applicability gate.
exitEvidence: VR-W06-01: Changing supported population, horizon or perturbations creates a new card revision with an explicit compatibility consequence.
VR-W06-02: The card distinguishes represented mechanisms from omitted organ or spatial processes; a broad engine name cannot imply unsupported resolution.
VR-W06-03: Code verification, reference agreement, empirical validation and qualified interpretation appear as separate evidence with identifiable sources.
VR-W06-04: A named extrapolation yields PARTIAL and blocks confirmatory promotion while retaining exploratory output and rationale.
VR-W06-05: An action outside a card's supported transitions is rejected before engine state mutation with the rejected capability recorded.
VR-W06-06: A credible contradictory result links to the affected card and claims rather than disappearing from supported-evidence lists.
VR-W06-07: Deprecation or upstream corrections identify affected studies and a replacement/reproduction route without rewriting historic cards.
VR-W06-08: A review samples every supported input and observable against the exact card; an uncovered request fails the applicability gate.

canonicalWaves.name: Source and data intake has reviewable stages
canonicalWaves.outcome: One admitted source can be traced from discovery through rights, scientific review, intake, derivation and allowed release with missing-stage falsifiers.
exitEvidence: VR-W07-01: A discoverable source cannot execute or enter a fixture until its rights, scientific and technical decisions are recorded separately.
VR-W07-02: Each transformed or packaged component retains its own terms and required notices; a paper license cannot silently license its data.
VR-W07-03: Every derived fixture identifies source entities, transformation version and resulting artifact so unexplained bytes fail provenance review.
VR-W07-04: Traversal, symlinks, nested expansion and excess size/file-count probes are rejected before files leave a bounded intake directory.
VR-W07-05: A proposed source derived from patient-level or controlled records is rejected even if labeled synthetic or de-identified.
VR-W07-06: A corrected or withdrawn upstream record identifies retained affected studies without silently replacing their pinned bytes.
VR-W07-07: Missing, changed or inaccessible source artifacts produce actionable records and never fall back to an unpinned alternative.
VR-W07-08: One admitted source can be traced from discovery through rights, scientific review, intake, derivation and allowed release with missing-stage falsifiers.

canonicalWaves.name: Units and semantic quantities survive interfaces
canonicalWaves.outcome: Cross-boundary known answers and wrong-frame, wrong-kind and residual perturbations exercise all supported exchange mappings.
exitEvidence: VR-W08-01: Each additional conversion has dimensional, numeric and round-trip evidence; unsupported UCUM syntax remains rejected.
VR-W08-02: Absolute and relative pressures or incompatible concentration bases cannot interchange despite matching dimensions.
VR-W08-03: Amount, concentration, flow and volume have distinct contract meanings and a same-unit wrong-kind example fails.
